verdict.rationale: The docs say Claude Code can run multiple tasks in parallel on the web and run multiple sessions side by side with visual diff review (docs-13, docs-14, docs-26), so parallel attempts are possible. However, the documented multi-agent feature splits one task into different parts and merges them, rather than generating alternative attempts to compare (docs-6). No evidence describes a built-in best-of-N workflow for comparing attempts and choosing one. Missing for 10: explicit support for multiple attempts at the same task, a side-by-side comparison and selection workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
